name: Instantly
tagline: Cold-email outreach software with a lead database, deliverability tools and AI-written sequences.
about: Instantly sends and manages outbound email campaigns. It includes inbox warm-up, a B2B lead database and one inbox for replies.
pros: Automatic inbox warm-up to protect deliverability.
cons: No free plan after the trial.
Cold email must be run carefully to stay within anti-spam laws.
